articles.title: Sombr Surprises Fans With Fleetwood Mac Legend Lindsey Buckingham
articles.summary: At his Los Angeles concert, singer Sombr brought out his hero Lindsey Buckingham to play the Fleetwood Mac classic "Go Your Own Way."

articles.title: Classic Space Game Wing Commander 3 Is Getting a Remaster
articles.summary: An Electronic Arts producer surprised fans at the Portland Retro Gaming Expo by announcing a 30th anniversary remaster of Wing Commander 3.

articles.title: Stare, Then Look Away: The Science of Afterimages
articles.summary: A Science Buddies experiment shows how tired cone cells in your eyes can make you see a ghostly image in a different color.
